name: LERCANIDIPINE 10 MG 30 TABLETS
description: Lercanidipine is a medication that belongs to the class of calcium channel blockers, used to treat mild to moderate hypertension (high blood pressure). It works by relaxing blood vessels so that blood flows more easily and blood pressure decreases. Main uses of lercanidipine: High blood pressure: Treats high blood pressure in adults over 18 years of age. The recommended dose is 10 mg once a day, but it may be adjusted to 20 mg depending on the patient’s response. Prevention of heart problems: By controlling high blood pressure, lercanidipine helps prevent serious complications, such as heart disease, heart attacks, and strokes. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
